    "Robust built-in features for a growing retail business.",
    "Ability to offer bulk discounts and handle complex product needs.",
    "More control and customization options compared to previous platform."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Themes and store interface can be challenging to customize without technical help.",
    "Occasional random glitches impacting store operations.",
    "Value for money might be questioned due to pricing structure or limited free options."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This owner, previously using Shopify, likely found BigCommerce to offer a more powerful and feature-rich platform suitable for scaling their retail business over the 1-2 years of use. While appreciating its robust functionality and built-in tools for managing products and discounts, they likely experienced a steeper learning curve and some frustrations with theme customization and occasional glitches. The transition might have highlighted BigCommerce's strengths in complex operations but also its comparative lack of intuitive ease-of-use for design compared to simpler alternatives, leading to a generally positive but somewhat mixed experience."
